events.short_description: Explain your income in a free first draft
events.long_description: W-2s and 1099s are out. Draft a free income letter, with a tax-time list of what to attach, then send it yourself.
events.why_this_season: W-2s are due to workers by 31 January and most 1099s by mid-February, when lenders and landlords start asking self-employed and new-job applicants to explain income.
events.in_app_tip: Tax time: if a lender or landlord asks about income, attach copies of this year's W-2s or 1099s, or last year's tax return if you are self-employed. Send copies, never originals.
events.in_app_content: The tip above shows at the top of this situation's first question only between starts and ends (src/seasonal.ts reads this file).

events.short_description: A free rental application letter, step by step
events.long_description: Renting? Draft a free rental application letter, with a rental-season list of what to attach, then send it yourself.
events.why_this_season: Most US moves happen from May to September, so rental applications peak from May.
events.in_app_tip: Rental season: landlords often choose fast. Have copies of recent pay stubs, a photo ID and one or two references ready to send with this letter.
events.in_app_content: The tip above shows at the top of this situation's first question only between starts and ends (src/seasonal.ts reads this file).

featuring_nomination.where: App Store Connect > Apps > ApprovalPrep > Featuring > Nominations (after the app is live)
featuring_nomination.name: ApprovalPrep: tax and rental season letters
featuring_nomination.description: ApprovalPrep is a self-help letter writer for people applying for a mortgage, loan, apartment or job, or fixing an error on a credit report. From late January, applicants are asked to explain income from W-2s and 1099s, and from May, rental applications peak. During each window the free Letter Studio adds a short seasonal list of what to attach to an income letter or a rental application letter, drafted one question at a time; the person checks it and sends it. No account, no upload: answers stay on the phone. Kits are one-time purchases, never a subscription.
featuring_nomination.audience: First-time renters, self-employed and new-job applicants, and anyone answering a lender's or landlord's question
featuring_nomination.accessibility: Body text is Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, a typeface made for low-vision readers
featuring_nomination.supplemental_materials: the two event images in this folder
